print.name: Creative to Magic Tonie Base
print.summary: Easy to print, create your own Tonie!
print.description:
I updated this (https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:3457710) as I noticed the diameter of the magnets in a Creative Tonie was 6mm wide. The original design was more like 10-12mm, which made the magnets rotate. Not sure if older Tonies had bigger magnets, but definitely, wanted mine to stay put and aligned together

So updated the size of the magnet holes to 7 mm wide.

####v2 File Update 1/19/25

I moved the magnet holes closer to the surface so the magnets will stick slightly better. Also, offset the chip hole so it wasn't exactly between the magnets. Not sure that the magnets hurt it, but in the normal Tonies, the chip is further away (usually higher, inside the figure).

###Magnet Spacer Update 4/19/25

I created a 6.5mm x 7mm height cylinder to act as a spacer above the magnet. This prevents the magnet rattle and makes the magnet stay at the bottom of the Tonie base.

Check out my other Tonie designs, Happy Printing!

Category: 3D Printing
